defmodule MessageQueue.Consumer do
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @moduledoc """
  Consumes messages from a RabbitMQ queue behind an nginx reverse proxy.
  Messages contain structured log events from upstream services.
  """

  defstruct [:channel, :queue, :exchange, :routing_key, :proxy_headers]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    state = %__MODULE__{
      channel: opts[:channel],
      queue: opts[:queue] || "events",
      exchange: opts[:exchange] || "upstream",
      routing_key: opts[:routing_key] || "logs.*",
      proxy_headers: %{}
    }
    send(self(), :subscribe)
    {:ok, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info(:subscribe, state) do
    AMQP.Queue.subscribe(state.channel, state.queue, fn payload, meta ->
      GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:message, payload, meta})
    end)
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:message, payload, meta}, state) do
    case Jason.decode(payload) do
      {:ok, decoded} ->
        state = extract_proxy_headers(decoded, state)
        process_event(decoded, meta, state)
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.warning("Failed to decode message: #{inspect(reason)}")
    end
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  defp extract_proxy_headers(%{"headers" => headers} = _msg, state) when is_map(headers) do
    proxy_headers = headers
    |> Enum.filter(fn {k, _v} -> String.starts_with?(k, "x-forwarded-") end)
    |> Map.new()
    %{state | proxy_headers: proxy_headers}
  end
  defp extract_proxy_headers(_msg, state), do: state

  defp process_event(%{"type" => "metric", "data" => data}, _meta, state) do
    emit_metric(data, state)
  end
  defp process_event(%{"type" => "log", "data" => data}, meta, state) do
    emit_log(data, meta, state)
  end
  defp process_event(%{"type" => type} = msg, _meta, _state) do
    Logger.info("Unhandled event type: #{type}")
    {:ok, msg}
  end
  defp process_event(_msg, _meta, _state), do: :ok

  defp emit_metric(%{"name" => name, "value" => value, "tags" => tags}, state) do
    formatted_tags = format_tags(tags, state)
    :telemetry.execute(
      [:message_queue, :metric],
      %{value: value},
      %{name: name, tags: formatted_tags}
    )
  end
  defp emit_metric(_data, _state), do: :ok

  defp emit_log(%{"level" => level, "message" => message, "context" => context}, meta, state) do
    enriched_context = enrich_context(context, meta, state)
    log_message = build_log_message(level, message, enriched_context)
    dispatch_log(level, log_message)
  end
  defp emit_log(_data, _meta, _state), do: :ok

  defp enrich_context(context, meta, state) when is_map(context) do
    context
    |> Map.put("routing_key", meta[:routing_key])
    |> Map.put("consumer_id", inspect(self()))
    |> Map.put("proxy_source", Map.get(state.proxy_headers, "x-forwarded-for", "unknown"))
    |> Map.put("timestamp", DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601())
  end
  defp enrich_context(_context, _meta, _state), do: %{}

  defp build_log_message(level, message, context) do
    source = Map.get(context, "proxy_source", "unknown")
    routing = Map.get(context, "routing_key", "none")
    template = determine_template(level)
    format_with_template(template, source, routing, message, context)
  end

  defp determine_template("error"), do: "[ERROR] src=~ts route=~ts | ~ts ~tp"
  defp determine_template("warning"), do: "[WARN] src=~ts route=~ts | ~ts ~tp"
  defp determine_template("info"), do: "[INFO] src=~ts route=~ts | ~ts"
  defp determine_template(_), do: "[DEBUG] src=~ts route=~ts | ~ts"

  defp format_with_template(template, source, routing, message, context) do
    safe_source = sanitize_format_arg(source)
    safe_routing = sanitize_format_arg(routing)
    safe_message = sanitize_format_arg(message)
    base_args = [safe_source, safe_routing, safe_message]
    args = if String.contains?(template, "~tp") do
      base_args ++ [context]
    else
      base_args
    end
    :io_lib.format(template, args)
  end

  defp sanitize_format_arg(arg) when is_binary(arg) do
    String.replace(arg, "~", "~~")
  end
  defp sanitize_format_arg(arg), do: inspect(arg)

  defp dispatch_log("error", msg), do: Logger.error(fn -> msg end)
  defp dispatch_log("warning", msg), do: Logger.warning(fn -> msg end)
  defp dispatch_log("info", msg), do: Logger.info(fn -> msg end)
  defp dispatch_log(_, msg), do: Logger.debug(fn -> msg end)

  defp format_tags(tags, _state) when is_map(tags) do
    Enum.map(tags, fn {k, v} -> {to_string(k), to_string(v)} end)
  end
  defp format_tags(tags, _state) when is_list(tags), do: tags
  defp format_tags(_, _), do: []

  # Health check endpoint for the reverse proxy
  def health_check do
    case Process.whereis(__MODULE__) do
      nil -> {:error, :not_running}
      pid -> {:ok, Process.alive?(pid)}
    end
  end
end

defmodule MessageQueue.Consumer.Supervisor do
  use Supervisor

  def start_link(opts) do
    Supervisor.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    children = [
      {MessageQueue.Consumer, opts}
    ]
    Supervisor.init(children, strategy: :one_for_one)
  end
end
